scope: Existing ProgramDefinition lifecycle; no new runtime/API or schema

target.database_id: Only from verified successful publication readback; never guessed

publication.published_by_technical_scope: Configured superadmin and not suppressed, read-only verified
publication.command: PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python scripts/publish_assessment_program.py --code specialist_pilot --version 1.2 --name 'Пилот 4К · 9 кейсов' --assignment-ref specialist-pilot --mode dialogue --configuration-code specialist_pilot_v1 --role-code specialist_expert --publisher-user-id 4 --pilot-plan-package assessment_definitions/planning/specialist_pilot_admission/v0.1 --publish

retirement.existing_transition: published -> retired only; cannot delete, edit snapshot, change roles, or republish retired version
retirement.runtime_cli: No existing retirement CLI/endpoint found; do not invent one
retirement.proposed_method: Explicitly authorized guarded administrative SQL through existing DB trigger, only for the newly published version; not a generic runtime tool
preconditions: Owner explicitly approves this limited operational method before publication.
Free isolated test of guard predicates and exact old/new column/role preservation passes before permanent publication.
Exact code/version/checksum/id verified; publication and export source drift absent.
No organization has ever connected to this new program; no participant history/AS is to be altered.
No concurrent operator/publication/connect action for this new version during the controlled release window; if quiescence cannot be established, STOP and request a separate recovery plan.
If any connection/history or unexpected source drift is present, do not retire/delete/rebind automatically.
retirement.sql_template: UPDATE assessment_program_definitions p SET status='retired' WHERE p.id=%s AND p.code='specialist_pilot' AND p.version='1.2' AND p.status='published' AND p.definition_checksum=%s AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_assessment_program_connections c WHERE c.program_definition_id=p.id) RETURNING p.id,p.code,p.version,p.status,p.definition_checksum
retirement.transaction: Explicit BEGIN, lock and read target row, assert exact identity and no connections; UPDATE must affect exactly 1 row; compare unchanged definition/roles; COMMIT then readback. Any failure -> ROLLBACK. Not a promise of inverse retirement or downgrade.
retirement.evidence_scope: Existing status transition/refusal tests passed in PR171 integration; new administrative guard procedure has NOT_RUN isolated regression and is not yet declared verified.
retirement.free_guard_regression: REQUIRED_BEFORE_ANY_PUBLICATION; NOT_RUN pending owner acceptance of operational method

post_publication: Read-only export exact program-version 1.2, no latest/fallback.
Independently verify source receipt bytes and definition/snapshot/case/QA/artifact checksums.
Confirm no org connections were made by this task; preserve old1.1.
Do not run paid PATH or activate/connect existing organizations.
